passages.text: In the third month, on the same day of the month that the Israelites had left the land of Egypt, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Egypt.
They traveled together as a people.
Three months passed after they left Egypt.
On that same day, they arrived at the Wilderness of Sinai.
passages.original: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לְצֵ֥את בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

passages.text: After they had set out from Rephidim, they entered the Wilderness of Sinai, and Israel camped there in front of the mountain.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Rephidim.
They traveled to the Wilderness of Sinai.
They camped in the wilderness.
Israel camped in front of the mountain.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵרְפִידִ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיִּֽחַן־ שָׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נֶ֥גֶד הָהָֽר׃

passages.text: Then Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain, “This is what you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses went up to God.
The LORD called to Moses from the mountain.
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “Speak to the house of Jacob.
Tell this to the sons of Israel.
You saw what I did to Egypt.
I punished Egypt.
I carried you out of Egypt.
I lifted you up as if on eagles’ wings.
I brought you to Myself.”
passages.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה עָלָ֖ה אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ מִן־ הָהָ֣ר לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לְבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתַגֵּ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְמִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ עַל־ כַּנְפֵ֣י נְשָׁרִ֔ים וָאָבִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God said, “If you obey My voice, you will keep My covenant.
If you keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession.
You will be My treasured possession out of all the nations.
All the earth belongs to Me.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אִם־ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּקֹלִ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֑י וִהְיִ֨יתֶם לִ֤י סְגֻלָּה֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כִּי־ לִ֖י כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses on the mountain.
God gave Moses a message for the Israelites.
God said, “You will be a kingdom of priests to Me.
You will be a holy nation to Me.
These are the words you must speak to the Israelites.”
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֧ם תִּהְיוּ־ לִ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְג֣וֹי קָד֑וֹשׁ אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses returned to the people.
Moses called for the elders of the people.
The elders were the leaders among the Israelites.
Moses gathered the elders together.
Moses placed before the elders all the words from the LORD.
The LORD had commanded Moses to speak these words.
Moses told the elders everything the LORD had commanded him.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֖א לְזִקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And all the people answered together, “We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.” So Moses brought their words back to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
All the Israelites answered together.
They said, “We will do everything the LORD has spoken.”
Moses took the people’s words.
Moses brought their words back to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ כָל־ הָעָ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַיָּ֧שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “I will come to you in a thick cloud.
I will do this so the people can hear when I speak with you.
Then the people will trust you forever.”
Moses told the LORD what the people had said.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י בָּ֣א אֵלֶיךָ֮ בְּעַ֣ב הֶֽעָנָן֒ בַּעֲב֞וּר יִשְׁמַ֤ע הָעָם֙ בְּדַבְּרִ֣י עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־ בְּךָ֖ יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַיַּגֵּ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes and be prepared by the third day, for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to go to the people of Israel.
The LORD told Moses to consecrate the people.
Moses must consecrate the people today and tomorrow.
The people must wash their clothes.
The people must be ready by the third day.
On the third day, the LORD will come down.
The LORD will come down on Mount Sinai.
All the people will see the LORD come down on the mountain.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ם הַיּ֖וֹם וּמָחָ֑ר וְכִבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃ וְהָי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כִּ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י יֵרֵ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ הָעָ֖ם עַל־ הַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

passages.text: And you are to set up a boundary for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command for the people of Israel.
God told Moses to set a boundary around Mount Sinai.
Moses must warn the people.
The people must not go up on the mountain.
The people must not touch the base of the mountain.
Anyone who touches the mountain will be put to death.
passages.original: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ֤ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ סָבִ֣יב לֵאמֹ֔ר הִשָּׁמְר֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם עֲל֥וֹת בָּהָ֖ר וּנְגֹ֣עַ בְּקָצֵ֑הוּ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהָ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

passages.text: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot with arrows—whether man or beast, he must not live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.”
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses a command for the people at Mount Sinai.
God said, “No one may touch the person who touches the mountain.
People must not use their hands to punish him.
They must kill him with stones or arrows.
This rule is for both people and animals.
No person or animal who touches the mountain may live.
When the ram’s horn sounds a long blast, the people may go up the mountain.”
passages.original: לֹא־ תִגַּ֨ע בּ֜וֹ יָ֗ד כִּֽי־ סָק֤וֹל יִסָּקֵל֙ אוֹ־ יָרֹ֣ה יִיָּרֶ֔ה אִם־ בְּהֵמָ֥ה אִם־ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יִחְיֶ֑ה בִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הַיֹּבֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה יַעֲל֥וּ בָהָֽר׃

passages.text: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses came down from the mountain.
He went to the people.
Moses consecrated the people.
The people washed their clothes.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִן־ הָהָ֖ר אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וַֽיְכַבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people.
He told them to get ready.
He said, "Be prepared for the third day."
He commanded them, "Do not go near a woman."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם הֱי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים אַֽל־ תִּגְּשׁ֖וּ אֶל־ אִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
passages.sermon:
On the third day, morning arrived.
Thunder sounded.
Lightning flashed.
A thick cloud covered the mountain.
A very loud blast from a ram’s horn rang out.
All the people in the camp trembled.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיֹ֣ת הַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיְהִי֩ קֹלֹ֨ת וּבְרָקִ֜ים וְעָנָ֤ן כָּבֵד֙ עַל־ הָהָ֔ר וְקֹ֥ל שֹׁפָ֖ר חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
He brought all the people out of their camp.
He led them to meet with God.
The people stood at the foot of the mountain.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־ הָעָ֛ם לִקְרַ֥את הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּתַחְתִּ֥ית הָהָֽר׃

passages.text: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
passages.sermon:
Mount Sinai stood as a mountain in the wilderness.
The LORD descended onto Mount Sinai.
The LORD came down in fire.
Smoke covered the entire mountain.
The smoke rose up like the smoke from a furnace.
The whole mountain shook violently.
passages.original: וְהַ֤ר סִינַי֙ עָשַׁ֣ן כֻּלּ֔וֹ מִ֠פְּנֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרַ֥ד עָלָ֛יו יְהוָ֖ה בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַיַּ֤עַל עֲשָׁנוֹ֙ כְּעֶ֣שֶׁן הַכִּבְשָׁ֔ן וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־ הָהָ֖ר מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
They stood at the foot of Mount Sinai.
God came down on the mountain in fire.
Smoke covered the mountain.
The whole mountain shook strongly.
A ram’s horn sounded.
The sound grew louder and louder.
Moses spoke to God.
God answered Moses with a voice like thunder.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר הוֹלֵ֖ךְ וְחָזֵ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יַעֲנֶ֥נּוּ בְקֽוֹל׃

passages.text: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit. So Moses went up, and the LORD said to him, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai.
Mount Sinai is a mountain where God met with Moses and the people of Israel.
The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain.
Moses went up to the top of Mount Sinai.
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD told Moses, "Go down."
The LORD told Moses, "Warn the people."
The LORD said, "Do not let the people break through to see the LORD."
The LORD warned, "If they break through, many of them will perish."
passages.original: וַיֵּ֧רֶד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקְרָ֨א יְהוָ֧ה לְמֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָ֖ר וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶֽׁה׃ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה רֵ֖ד הָעֵ֣ד בָּעָ֑ם פֶּן־ יֶהֶרְס֤וּ אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ לִרְא֔וֹת וְנָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ רָֽב׃

passages.text: Even the priests who approach the LORD must consecrate themselves, or the LORD will break out against them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
Priests sometimes approach the LORD.
These priests must make themselves holy.
If the priests do not make themselves holy, the LORD will break out against them.
passages.original: וְגַ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים הַנִּגָּשִׁ֥ים אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה יִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ פֶּן־ יִפְרֹ֥ץ בָּהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But Moses said to the LORD, “The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned us, ‘Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD.
He said, “The people cannot go up Mount Sinai.
You gave us a clear warning.
You said, ‘Set a boundary around the mountain.
Make the mountain holy.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה לֹא־ יוּכַ֣ל הָעָ֔ם לַעֲלֹ֖ת אֶל־ הַ֣ר סִינָ֑י כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֞ה הַעֵדֹ֤תָה בָּ֙נוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַגְבֵּ֥ל אֶת־ הָהָ֖ר וְקִדַּשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And the LORD replied, “Go down and bring Aaron with you. But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the LORD, or He will break out against them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “Go down the mountain.
Bring Aaron with you when you come back up.
The priests must not force their way up to the LORD.
The people must not force their way up to the LORD.
If the priests or the people break through, the LORD will break out against them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ לֶךְ־ רֵ֔ד וְעָלִ֥יתָ אַתָּ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהָעָ֗ם אַל־ יֶֽהֶרְס֛וּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה פֶּן־ יִפְרָץ־ בָּֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses went down from the mountain.
Moses went to the people of Israel.
Moses spoke to the people.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥רֶד מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃ס
